# We Work Remotely RSS fixture

`sample.xml` is a **real captured response**, truncated to the first 6
`<item>` elements. It is public job-listing data and contains no personal
data: no names of applicants, no contact details, no account data.

- Captured: 2026-10-09
- Source: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss
- Original size: 778685 bytes; fixture: 60067 bytes
- Truncation keeps the channel header, 6 items, and the closing tags.
- Re-fetching is subject to the same access policy as the live source;
  these tests never do it.
